etsy.title: Gingerbread Man Crochet Pattern PDF, Mini Christmas Ornament, Easy Flat Pieces in Single Crochet, Tree Decoration, English German
etsy.description:
A sweet little gingerbread man for the tree, a gift tag or an advent garland: head, body, arms and legs in single crochet, sewn together and finished with white yarn details. About 1.5 hours.

• Skill level: easy (2/6), you need magic ring, sc and increases
• Size: about 9 × 11 cm (3.5 × 4.3 in) in worsted yarn
• Hook: 4 mm
• Yarn: about 10 g light brown + 2 g white

WAYS TO USE IT: tree ornament, gift tag, garland, place card.

PDF PATTERN ONLY – not the finished item. Instant download in English (US terms + UK table) and German (Deutsch).
Includes a stitch chart (symbol diagram), a finished-shape sketch with measurements and a symbol key.
New pattern: the first image is the stitch chart; a maker-tested photo will be added.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales with credit to AureliaVenn. Please don't share or resell the pattern.

Written with the help of AI tools; stitch counts checked round by round.
